searchText: **EIP-1559 Implementers' Call #3 is scheduled for June 24th, 19:00 UTC** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/184 Call will be streamed on YT and zoom link will be posted in the <#692078615269212180> channel before. The goals for the call would be to get to a resolution on if and how we want to bundle 1559 and escalator fees (for now), and how we go about testing/analyzing the fee market changes. Feel free to leave comments to add things to the agenda. Edit: date changed from the 25th to the 24th. Eth 1.X call in about 24 hours I'm on vacation this week with my family. So I'll miss it. But looking forward to catching up when I get back I will be without cell service for most of it. So if I don't respond, that is why 😅
